transcript.statement: Sustainability is crucial for the autonomous driving system. GRN-01 ensures energy efficiency by optimizing path and speed profiles, vital for reducing operational costs and environmental impact. GRN-02 emphasizes renewable energy for charging, aligning with global sustainability goals. GRN-03 addresses lifecycle assessments to minimize resource impact, which is essential for responsible manufacturing. GRN-04 focuses on energy recovery during braking, enhancing efficiency. GRN-05 targets carbon emissions reduction, contributing to climate goals. GRN-06 promotes energy-efficient routing, while GRN-07 establishes emergency protocols to minimize energy use in crises, ensuring a holistic approach to sustainability.

transcript.statement: The TrustworthinessAgent emphasizes the paramount importance of security and privacy in the Autonomous Driving System. TRU-01 ensures robust data encryption, protecting user data from unauthorized access. TRU-02 establishes access controls, vital for restricting permissions and safeguarding sensitive information. TRU-03 mandates logging for auditability, enabling accountability in data handling. TRU-04 protects user identities through anonymization, crucial for privacy. TRU-05 enforces regular security audits to identify vulnerabilities, while TRU-06 secures remote updates to prevent malware threats. Lastly, TRU-07 informs users about data collection, fostering transparency and trust. These requirements are foundational for the system’s integrity and user trust.

transcript.statement: The EfficiencyAgent emphasizes the necessity of optimizing performance efficiency in the autonomous driving system. requirements.text: The system shall implement a multi-layer safety architecture ensuring collision protection and fail-safe operations.
The system shall execute Minimal Risk Maneuvers promptly, ensuring safety during critical failures while allowing temporary relaxation of jerk limits.
The system shall continuously monitor Operational Design Domain compliance and issue human takeover requests when necessary.
The system shall maintain a jerk value below 0.5 m/s³ during normal operation and ensure operational efficiency.
The system shall monitor and optimize energy consumption during emergency maneuvers to align with sustainability goals.
The system shall implement robust data encryption and access controls to protect user data and ensure integrity.
The system shall conduct regular security audits and maintain documentation for accountability.
The system shall ensure that secure remote updates are implemented with fallback mechanisms during emergencies.
The system shall optimize path planning to achieve a minimum 30% reduction in travel time while maintaining safety.
The system shall achieve at least a 15% reduction in energy consumption during operation.
The system shall provide real-time monitoring of carbon emissions during operation to ensure compliance with sustainability goals.
The system shall utilize renewable energy sources for all charging stations within the operational design domain.
The system shall implement lifecycle assessments for all components to minimize resource impact.
